candidates.name: neighborhood_consensus_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Across the pooled validation traces, summarizing similarity-weighted target support among the six closest references will improve macro-average accuracy over query-diverse retrieval when nearby examples disagree, with only a modest context increase.

candidates.name: similarity_gated_correction_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Across the pooled validation traces, showing prior mistakes only alongside close corrected cases and relevant successes will improve macro-average accuracy over ungated error memory by reducing the influence of unrelated corrections.

candidates.name: repeated_line_factoring_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Across the pooled validation traces, factoring verbatim repeated lines out of reference examples will reduce injected context while retaining enough example-specific evidence to match or exceed instruction-anchored memory accuracy.
